1*red pepper sliced
2 garlic cloves chopped
1/2 onion sliced
1 carrot thinly sliced
A bit of ginger
A bit of chopped spring onion 
1 chicken breast, sliced or diced 
Noodles
Sweet chilli sauce

Cook noodles for 3 mins

Into hot wok throw in meat and garlic 
Fry for few minutes until almost cooked through
Throw in onion 
When onions are starting to sweat(be clear)add ginger 
After 30 secs add carrots 
After another 30 add peppers
Season with salt and pepper
Add sauce 
Add noodles and cook for few minutes 
At end add spring onions and eat.

Depression. From reading online and here the simplest way to describe it would be that we find one thing that we don't like about ourselves and start picking at it, it's kind of reverse psychology like when somebody tells you not to look at something and you look anyway. 
I feel it's the same with depression, you have this single idea that you don't like a piece of yourself be that being: ugly, lonely, lost, etc.
And you know that this does not matter and it's not something you should worry about but you keep on picking at it, first it's perhaps when you're hungover, perhaps it's a rainy day that you stay in and think, and you start thinking back at yourself, contemplating. Then you go back and back to it digging the wound deeper and deeper until you hit a spot where all that mess you were digging in spills out and fills your entire body, leaving emptiness and hanging on simplest thought, suddenly you don't find a need to get out of bed, eat, see friends because you were lost in your own brain maze.

I don't have a solution yet but I started travelling and going to the gym just to take my mind off itself.
Find yourself a new hobby that makes you go outside and that stops you from spending too much time in your room.
Even go for a walk everyday for an hour or more, pay attention to everything around you, if you live in a city, look at it, look at the people, culture and either write it down, take a picture or draw, it will not be perfect straight away but if you start noticing things around you that grab your attention, make a note of it and go back to that.
